questions.explanation:
Aryl halides are less reactive towards nucleophilic aromatic substitution with aqueous .

Introduction of electron releasing group like group further decreases its reactivity towards nucleophilic substitution. But the introduction of electron-withdrawing groups like group particularly at the ortho and para position increases its reactivity towards nucleophilic substitution. Higher the number of electron withdrawing groups, higher the reactivity.
